title: Calibration: what does 'the look' mean to you?
intro: Before the pack's look gets locked in, I need your taste in writing. The first questions compare today's baseline (Sildur's Vibrant) and ask what you want. At the end are the first frames from OUR shader pack (milestone 1, still unfinished) so you can react to the real thing. Text questions show a real-world reference photo for each option (and our own render, once it exists), so judge the mood rather than our early shader. Tap a choice, add a sentence if you want (the keyboard mic works), then send the round.

scenes.name: Ocean at noon · Vibrant High

options.critic: Baseline. Reflections and water read well. The near shore water is very flat and the far horizon haze is thin.
options.label: Current settings

options.critic: Costs about 10% frame rate. In this midday ocean shot it is nearly identical; volumetric light only shows near sunrise and sunset, or through leaves.
options.label: Sharper, longer shadows + volumetric light

options.label: Flat (no normal maps)

options.critic: Same algorithm for vanilla and modded textures so they stay consistent. Under Vibrant the effect is subtle; our own shader can use it far more strongly.

scenes.name: Effects to avoid
scenes.notePrompt: For example motion blur, depth of field, lens flare, heavy bloom, film grain, blurry anti-aliasing, overly dark caves.
